pages.title: Ginger for Walls
pages.text: Frosted gingerbread and white lights turn the first crop into a distinctive festive building.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find Wild Ginger in Sparse Jungle, cultivate it and use gingerbread blocks, doors or stairs as building materials, not just food.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Collect Date bunches directly or knock them from island trees with projectiles. The native fieldguide supplies two harvesting methods.

pages.title: Related possibilities
